issue.schema.json.title: Login loops after password reset on Safari

links.title: Set Secure on the reset cookie

issue.schema.json.content:
## Problem

After resetting a password, Safari users land back on the sign-in page in a loop.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reset lands on the dashboard in Safari
- [ ] Regression test for the cookie flags

issue.schema.json.title: Password reset email arrives after the link expires
issue.schema.json.content: Links were valid for 10 minutes; some mail providers deliver after 12–15. Now valid for 60 minutes.
